title: Runner orchestration: usher_order, auto-promote, structured logging
problem: The runner has no dependency-aware ticket ordering, no auto-promote from backlog, and only a flat overnight.jsonl for logging. Multi-ticket efforts from usher splits cannot execute in the correct order overnight, and failed runs lack structured logs for debugging.
description: Implement runner orchestration upgrades that consume usher output. (1) usher_order.json: manifest file at runner/usher_order.json listing all tickets for runner pickup, organized into groups (with group_id, depends_on chains) and standalone entries. Each entry has uuid, slug, depends_on list, and status (pending/running/completed/failed/blocked). (2) Auto-promote loop: runner reads usher_order.json, finds first ticket where status=pending and all depends_on UUIDs have status=completed, copies from backlog/ to intake/, updates status to running, executes, then updates to completed/failed. On failure, mark all dependents in same group as blocked. All tickets moved to pickup folders must have a record in usher_order. (3) usher_order_archive/: when archiving, append _YYYY_MM_DD to filename. (4) run_history.jsonl: append-only structured log replacing overnight.jsonl. One JSON line per run with uuid, slug, exit_status, tokens, timestamps, stages_completed. (5) runner/logs/runner_log_YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS.log: per-run verbose debug logs. (6) Stale running detection: if status=running with no active process, reset to pending. (7) Fallback: if usher_order.json missing or malformed, fall back to current behavior. Group identity tracked in both ticket JSON (optional group_id field) and usher_order.json.
scope: New: runner/usher_order.py (order file management), runner/run_history.py (structured logging), runner/usher_order_archive/ (directory), runner/logs/ (directory), runner/test_usher_order.py, runner/test_run_history.py. Modified: runner/detached_lib.py, runner/run.py, runner/config.json.
